name: The Caretaker
role: Looks after the house — what the office needs from your server, and what's left for you to do
bubble.loading: One moment, I'm walking through the house…
bubble.all_good: Everything's in place — nothing for you to do.

bubble.todo.one: There's one thing you still need to do yourself.
bubble.todo.other: There are {n} things you still need to do yourself.

todo_text: Without these, a desk can't do (part of) its job. Only you can do them — in Unraid itself.
advice_text: Not a must, but it makes life easier or safer.
hints_text: Nothing to fix — just so you know.
all_good_text: Every desk has what it needs.
check.unraid_how: Update Unraid under Tools → Update OS.
check.community_apps_how: The app store for plugins and containers. Install it on the Plugins page (Install Plugin).
check.compose_manager_how: The office runs as a compose stack. With Compose Manager you start, stop and update it on Unraid's Docker page. Install it from Apps.
check.fix_common_problems_how: Checks the server for common mistakes and warns early. Install it from Apps.
check.files_viewer_how: Look at files and logs — Mr. Backup's too — right in Unraid's web UI. Install it from Apps.
check.notifications: Unraid's alerts reach you by mail or push
check.notifications_how: Switch on mail or an agent (Pushover, Telegram, …) for alerts under Settings → Notifications — otherwise nobody hears about a failed backup or a dying disk.
check.mail_subject_how: On purpose? Change it under Settings → Notifications → SMTP, so you can tell which server is writing.
check.pin: Changing things in the office needs a PIN
check.pin_how: ⋯ → Protect with a PIN. Reading stays open for everyone in your LAN.
check.other_backup_plugin_how: Make sure it doesn't back up the same things as Mr. Backup at the same time — or that this is on purpose.
check.other_backup_container_how: Make sure it doesn't back up the same things as Mr. Backup at the same time — or that this is on purpose.
check.other_backup_script_how: Make sure it doesn't back up the same things as Mr. Backup at the same time — or that this is on purpose.
done_sub: Everything that is already in place.
help.todo: Needed by a desk to do (part of) its job — only you can do it, in Unraid itself.
help.advice: Not a must, but it makes life easier or safer.
help.hints: Nothing to fix — just so you know (e.g. other backup tools on the server).
help.missing: Something needed isn't there or isn't set up.
help.not_yet: A recommendation that isn't followed yet.
help.unknown: I couldn't find out — e.g. Kopia hasn't been checked yet.
help.desk_text: Who needs it: every desk tells me what it needs from the server, I collect it.
help.open_text: Open the matching page of Unraid's web UI (Plugins, Apps, Docker, User Scripts, Notifications) in a new tab.
help.again: Looks at everything again right now; otherwise I do when the page is opened and my last look is older than 5 minutes.
